info.title: Novate Platform API
info.description: Enterprise Digital Workspace Platform API. This API provides endpoints for authentication, organization management, dynamic form building, data collection, project management, analytics, reports, and notifications.

get.description: Returns organization-wide analytics including totals, submission trends (14 days), and top forms.
Returns dashboard KPIs including active projects, published forms, submissions today, and task completion rate.

post.description: Creates a new user account with an organization. Returns user data, organization UUID, and Bearer token.

email: The email has already been taken.

post.description: Authenticates user with email and password. Returns user data and Bearer token.
Revokes current token and issues a new one.
Sends a password reset email to the given address.

status.example: We have emailed your password reset link.

post.description: Resets the password using a token from the reset email.

put.description: Updates the authenticated user's profile information.

get.description: Verifies the user's email address via signed URL.
Returns paginated list of forms for the current organization.

post.description: Creates a new form with sections and fields. Supports draft and published status.

get.description: Returns a single form with all sections, fields, and versions.

put.description: Updates form structure. Creates a new version if published.

delete.description: Deletes form and all associated sections, fields, versions.

post.description: Publishes the form, creates a version snapshot, and makes it available for submissions.
Archives the form, making it unavailable for new submissions.

get.description: Returns paginated list of submissions for the current organization.

post.description: Creates a new form submission with payload data. Supports file uploads, GPS coordinates, and offline sync via external_id.

payload.description: Form field values as key-value pairs

external_id.description: Client-generated ID for offline sync deduplication

get.description: Returns a single submission with form, user, and file data.

put.description: Updates an existing submission. Cannot update already submitted submissions.

delete.description: Deletes a submission and its associated files.

get.description: Returns paginated list of notifications for the authenticated user.
Returns the count of unread notifications.
Returns paginated list of organizations the user belongs to.

post.description: Creates a new organization and sets the user as owner.

get.description: Returns a single organization by UUID.

delete.description: Deletes an organization and its memberships.

get.description: Returns all users belonging to the organization.

post.description: Invites a user by email to join the organization with a specific role.
Switches the user's current active organization context.

get.description: Returns paginated list of report exports for the current organization.

post.description: Queues an export job for submissions in CSV, XLSX, or PDF format.

get.description: Returns a single export record with its status and file path.

sanctum.description: Enter your Bearer token obtained from auth/login or auth/register. Format: Bearer <token>
sanctum.name: Authorization

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Register, login, logout, password reset, email verification

tags.name: Forms
tags.description: Dynamic form builder with sections, fields, conditional logic

tags.name: Submissions
tags.description: Form data submission, file uploads, GPS data, offline sync

tags.name: Reports
tags.description: Export reports in CSV, XLSX, and PDF formats
